parts.text: Edit this image: make her head SLIGHTLY SMALLER so it is in better proportion with her body, still a bobble head but a little less oversized, and make her face more feminine and clearly ADULT: a grown woman with defined cheekbones, a slimmer jaw, a slightly longer face and adult features, never a child or baby face. Keep her grey hair curls, the stitched scar, blue veins, bloody hands, the floating chairs, outfit, backpack, pose and the asylum backdrop exactly the same.
